target: Kingdom Rush Frontiers Steam full-content build

features.description: Keep all campaign/elite content and challenge availability unlocked as appropriate
Max upgrades by default plus reset-for-custom behavior
Expose all hero implementations present in the full Steam build with level/skill controls
Custom enemy/unit selector using classes/templates actually present in the full build
Send all authored waves while preserving boss and special entrance hooks
Suppress normal end-of-stage victory until disabled or instant win is used
High-entity back-pressure/throttling where compatible with the Lua engine
Immediately activate all authored waves, wall-clock timer, per-stage/mode best time
Recycle enemies from path end to path start without life loss/exit rewards while preserving state where possible
